style: Bright picture-book pond look for a kindergarten math lesson: soft round shapes, cheerful clear colors, easy to read from the back of a classroom.

assets.name: pond
assets.prompt: Empty background: a big calm pond seen from above at a gentle angle, clear blue-green water filling almost the whole picture, a thin grassy bank with reeds, cattails and a few round stones only along the very top edge and the corners, soft sunlight sparkles on the water. No lily pads, no animals, no people.

assets.name: pad
assets.prompt: One round green lily pad seen from directly above, perfectly flat and almost circular, with one small wedge-shaped notch and gentle leaf veins.

assets.name: padflower
assets.prompt: One round green lily pad seen from directly above, almost circular with a small notch, with one white water lily flower with a yellow center sitting at its edge.

assets.name: frog
assets.prompt: A cute cartoon green frog sitting, front view, big friendly eyes, wide smile, light green belly.

assets.name: frogjump
assets.prompt: The same cute cartoon green frog in the middle of a big happy leap, legs stretched out behind, front arms forward, seen from the side.
